ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

3. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. watt (W)

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dangers of heat? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dangers of heat.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Dangers of heat.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dangers of heat.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dangers of heat.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping safe in? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping safe in.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping safe in.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping safe in.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping safe in.

10. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and its resources.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Heat and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Heat and its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Heat and its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Heat and its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Heat and its resources.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Animals and its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Energy: Heat and its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Uses of heat in and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Dangers of heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. A — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

3. C — Producers

4. C — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

7. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when.

8. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dangers of heat.

10. A — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

11. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and its resources.

12. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Heat and its resources.
